findings.finding: The new selected matrix maps authenticated NOT_INVOKED after consumed intent to FAILED/dispatchCount1 with outcomeCode TIMEOUT or CANCELLED. TIMEOUT is a supported FAILED report; CANCELLED is not. Actual GuidedActionLedger.verifyReport permits FAILED only with ASSERTION_FAILED/TARGET_CHANGED/POLICY_DENIED/TIMEOUT; both ordinary/guided-v2 outcome service paths call this verifier. CANCELLED being present in a scalar schema enum does not establish a valid FAILED/CANCELLED pair. Current stop uses REVOKED/CANCELLED only for unconsumed ADMITTED actions and UNKNOWN_OUTCOME/ACK_LOST for already DISPATCHING. R2 says it reuses existing ledger codes without widening old semantics, but does not select a source-compatible cancellation pair or specify a narrowly authorized new verifier branch/ownership.
findings.impact: Implementers could reject the real owning-worker conclusive cancellation accounting as INVALID_CONTRACT, invent an unchecked ledger write, or globally widen legacy cancellation semantics. The command/permit/ledger/session terminal association is not unambiguous for this planned positive branch despite the valid NOT_INVOKED wrapper.
